ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85-90% low-intensity (black) and 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixels on visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity region across central and right lobes; focal high-intensity (white) mottle cluster at the left lateral tip; scattered white annular micro-clusters (2-10px) across the dark mid-section.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle approximately 110-120 degrees; vertical bounding-box depth approximately 45 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire visible boundary; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude ranges from 3 to 12 pixels; one distinct deeper notch located 120 pixels left of the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve on the visible left lobe sweep; right lobe sweep partially occluded but follows a similar convex path.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-15px diameter) distributed non-uniformly across the dark pigmentation zone, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, narrow (1-2px width) white linear pixel disruptions visible near the median notch and central left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring/pigmentation localized on the far left tip; irregular notch/indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense high-intensity water cavitation/spray obscuring the lower horizontal boundary of both fluke lobes.
